The humidity ratio of all of the data center air streams is assumed to be constant. A constant humidity ratio is assumed because when the outdoor air temperatures are low enough to reuse the heat, there would not be a need for evaporative cooling (raising the humidity ratio), or chilled water cooling (lowering the humidity ratio).
